per_rule.rule: S_N should be unique because it behaves as a record-level join key; duplicate serial numbers are violations.
Every S_N in Acc_Info_dirty must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N.
Account_No must be a 4-digit numeric account number stored as text.
Full_Name should use consistent personal-name casing; flag names containing lowercase starts or all-uppercase words outside accepted particles such as bin, binte, d/o, and s/o.
ID must follow the dominant identifier structure: one letter, followed by 7 digits, ending with one letter.
ID should be unique across account records.
JoinDate must not be null.
JoinDate must be a parseable date/datetime value in the observed ISO-style date or timestamp format.
JoinDate must not be in the future.
LastLogin must be a parseable datetime in the observed 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format.
Subscription_Type must be one of the approved subscription tiers: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, or Premium.
SubscriptionFee must be numeric when populated; non-numeric text values are invalid.
If Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be null, missing, or 0 after numeric conversion.
If Subscription_Type is not 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be present and numeric.
Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
AccountBalance must not use the explicit sentinel value 99999.0.
PreferredLanguage must be one of the approved observed languages: English, French, German, Malay, or Tamil.
Device must be one of Desktop, Mobile, or Tablet.
OS must use one of the canonical operating system names: Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, or macOS.
FeedbackScore must be between 1 and 5 inclusive.
FeedbackScore1 must be between 1 and 5 inclusive.
JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin.
For names containing the particles 'Bin' or 's/o', the linked Cust_Bio_dirty.Gender value must be Male; for names containing 'Binte' or 'd/o', the linked Gender value must be Female.
ID must exactly match the linked Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No for the same S_N.
Account_No must exactly match the linked Cust_Bio_dirty.Account_No for the same S_N.
FeedbackScore and FeedbackScore1 should match exactly if they represent the same duplicated feedback measure.
Account_No must be unique within Acc_Info_dirty
FeedbackScore must not contain sentinel placeholder values
